name: m4-leyden-nolink
description: Follows `m4-leyden-l2-jit` (scala `LEYDEN.md`): a cache without replayed profiles still costs +6.4% instructions per op over cold. Is it JEP 483's class linking?

`aot-nolink`'s cache is created with `-XX:-AOTClassLinking`: classes come from the cache (and its training profiles replay) but are not pre-linked, and no `invokedynamic` call site is pre-resolved. If it matches cold in instructions, the pre-linking is the cause. Build `1e85ab8eba`, stock JDK 26 integration build, m4.

variantDescriptions.aot-nolink: cache trained by a `-wi 8 -i 5` fork with `-XX:-AOTClassLinking`
